jcr:content.shortDescription: A children's play park with a kiosk and open parkland in Fishponds.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Oldbury Court is a useful choice when the playground is the priority. The estate also has space for a picnic and paths for a short walk if the family wants to keep moving afterwards.

Our family idea: let each child choose a favourite piece of equipment, then take a break together before another round. Keep any riverside extension optional so the youngest visitors do not run out of energy.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Children aged 13 and under visiting with their family.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Play park, cafe kiosk, terrace seating and toilets with baby changing.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the Oldbury Court Road car park and check current charges and gate times.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Choose equipment appropriate to each child. The River Frome is elsewhere in the estate, so supervise closely if you add a riverside walk.

placevisitmap.travelNote: Use the Oldbury Court Road car park and check current charges and gate times. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
